title: Kenvue exhibits at the 2024 American Academy of Dermatology meeting
summary: On Friday and Saturday, Kenvue experts and key opinion leaders will also host the following R&D Theater presentations.
body_markdown:
## **FRIDAY**


###


**Retinol at 10:30 am**


- Efficacy and Tolerability of Topical 0.1% Stabilized Bioactive Retinol for Photoaging: A Vehicle-Controlled Integrated Analysis
- Patricia Farris MD, MS, FAAD, Department of Dermatology, Tulane University School of Medicine, New Orleans, LA


**Neostrata® at 12:00 pm**


- Bounce Back in 2024: Rebound Sculpting Cream Formulated with Breakthrough MicroDipeptide229 Technology
- Heather Mott, Principal Scientist Dermocosmetics, R&D, Kenvue


**BAND-AID® Brand Adhesive Bandages at 1:00 pm**


- Bringing the power of hydrocolloid healing to your patients
- Dr. Asha Patel Shah, MD, MBA, FAAD, Director of Medical Sciences, Skin Health & Beauty, Kenvue


**Acne at 2:00 pm**


- Neutrogena Stubborn Acne Innovations, Treating and Healing with a Holistic Approach: Adapalene, Patches, Body Cleansing & Supplements
- Barbara Green, RPh, Senior Director, R&D, Kenvue


**Pre-Aging at 2:45 pm**


- Fundamental Studies on Multicultural Pre-Aging Skin
- Marisa Dufort, Innovation Lead Future of Skin Health & Beauty, Kenvue


**Aveeno® — Oat at 3:30 pm**


- The Power of Oat for Sensitive Skin
- Jipsha Thakrar, Manager Body Therapeutic Moisture, Skincare Product Design, Skin Health & Beauty, Kenvue


###


---


###


## **SATURDAY**


###


**Sun at 10:30 am**


- Sun Care Science and Innovation Update
- Joshua D. Williams, PhD, Manager, Skin Health & Beauty R&D, Kenvue


**Rogaine® at 12:00 pm**


- Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow: Filling the Hair Loss Education Gap to Drive Earlier Use and Improved Outcomes
- Paul LaTerra, Director, R&D, Kenvue


**Hydro Boost® — Hydration/Cleansing at 1:30 pm**


- Neutrogena® Hydro Boost: Next Generation Gentle Cleansing and Hydrating Moisturizers
- Julie Bianchini, PhD, Manager, Skin Health & Beauty R&D, Kenvue


**Aveeno® — Pediatrics and Eczema at 2:30 pm**


- Managing pediatric skin before and after eczema diagnosis: Practical Pearls from Board Certified-Pediatric Dermatologist Dr. Candrice Heath
- Candrice Heath, MD FAAP FAAD, Assistant Professor of Dermatology, Clinical Researcher and Director of Pediatric Dermatology at the Lewis Katz School of Medicine, Temple University
- M. Catherine Mack Ph.D., Associate Director, Baby Care Research & Development Kenvue
